sqlTemplate:
WITH new_art_cd4_lt200 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.client_id, s.baseline_regimen_start_date
  FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
  WHERE s.baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate AND s.baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate
    AND s.baseline_cd4 IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(s.baseline_cd4 AS UNSIGNED) < 200
    AND (:location IS NULL OR s.location_id = :location)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT art.client_id) AS total
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card art
INNER JOIN new_art_cd4_lt200 n ON art.client_id = n.client_id
WHERE art.encounter_date >= :startDate AND art.encounter_date < :endDate
  AND art.tb_lam_results = "Positive"
  AND art.tb_regimen IS NOT NULL
  AND (:location IS NULL OR art.location_id = :location);
